messages:
Maria Chen: quick status—we're T-3 days to the OnPrem roll for GreenLeaf. Need a concise owner check and blockers list.
Kevin Patel: I can own network gating. VPC peering and route tables are done in staging, still need final NAT IPs from customer.
Tara Singh: @Kevin noted. waiting on their infra team to confirm egress NAT IPs and proxy thumbprint. Pinged them this morning.
Jonas Berg: Registry sync: images pushed to airgap tar, but cert for the registry is expiring in 9 days. Need cert rotation plan.
Maria Chen: Jonas can you post the cert thumbprint and where you're storing the backup? also, anyone owning the canary window?
Jonas Berg: thumbprint: `SHA256:3a:7b:...:f2` (shortened). Backup location: `s3://airgap-backups/greenleaf/2026-03-15` — access already given to Ops Lead.
Ops Lead: I will take canary ownership for the first 2-hour window on the 19th. Need runbook link and rollback steps.
Anya V: Runbook updated here: https://console/internal/runbooks/onprem-greenleaf (internal). Key steps: rollback label -> `kubectl set image` -> traffic cutover to fallback cluster.
Luis M: KMS/HSM — customer wants customer-managed keys. Waiting on their SOC to complete key import. ETA tomorrow end-of-day.
Kevin Patel: firewall rules: please confirm TCP 443, 22 (SSH), 2379 (etcd) are allowed from our bastion subnet. Also need ephemeral port range for healthcheck: 30000-32767.
Tara Singh: Confirmed with customer: 443+2379 allowed, but SSH to bastions only via jumpbox. They won't open ephemeral ports; we can switch healthchecks to TLS over 443 if OK.
Maria Chen: OK, plan: Jonas rotate certs today; Kevin finalize firewall PR with jumpbox-only SSH; Luis chase KMS import; Ops Lead prepare canary runbook and shift responsibilities to oncall after 2 hours. Any blockers on image signing?
Jonas Berg: image signing: `cosign` signatures are attached. Customer wants signed digest in manifest—done. One small ask: add `SBOM` artifact. I'll upload by EOD.
infra-bot: deploy-check: preflight passed (images, manifests, net checks) — 8 tests failed -> 0, 12 warnings -> 3. See logs: https://ci.internal/reports/6390012345
Kevin Patel: I'll open PR for firewall rules now: `gitlab.com/infra/greenleaf/-/merge_requests/89` tagging @Tara for approval.
Tara Singh: LGTM, I'll review in the morning. Can Ops Lead confirm oncall rotation post-canary?
Ops Lead: confirmed, oncall picks up at 10:30 UTC after canary. I'll add escalation contacts to the runbook.
Maria Chen: thanks all — I'll post a final readiness note once Jonas and Luis confirm their items. :thumbsup:
